description.value:
This tiny metallic barbell is strangely heavy for its size. The spell attack modifier of any spell cast by Activating this item is [[/r 1d20+14 #spell attack roll]]{+14} and the DC of any spell cast by Activating this item is 24.

  • Armor You gain resistance 2 to force.

  • Weapon After casting a spell by Activating the cerebral barbell, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional @Damage[3[force]] damage until the end of your next turn.
